title: Implement batch detail page with prospect table
description: Implement the batch detail page at /batches/[id]. Shows all prospects for the batch in a table with status indicators. Entry point for triggering generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows batch name, industry, created date
Table shows all prospects: name, industry, location, status (badge), actions
Status badge uses color coding: pending=gray, processing=blue, ready=green, failed=red
'Preview' link per row navigates to /preview/[slug] when status=ready
'Edit' link per row navigates to /edit/[slug] when status=ready
'Regenerate' button per row triggers single-prospect generation
Generation trigger section visible at top of page (see TASK-62)
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Server component. Load batch by id via `getBatch(id)`. Load all prospects via `getProspectsByBatch(id)`. Render batch header and prospect table.

shadcn/ui Table with columns: Business Name, Industry, Location, Status (badge), Actions (Preview/Edit/Regenerate). Link Preview and Edit only when status is 'ready'. All status values get colored badges.
If batch not found, render a 'Batch not found' message with a link back to /batches.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify batch info header and prospect table are visible with status badges.
